box-header.title: The edge cluster could not be read

label.text: A local node links to each live member at its link address, and reaches a member with none only through the address it paired with, where any member may answer. Set edge_link_url on every member, each to its own public https address (a port when it is not 443).

Edge nodes on one database with one .env, so one link key, that each take links. Every member's answer to a local node lists the live ones with their link addresses, and the local node links to each and takes work from each; Clients shows the links to this member. Without a front node, publish an address record, an MX record and the SRV records for each member.
One member: local nodes dial it at the address they paired with, so it needs no link address. Set edge_link_url on each member before a second one starts.
